messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Alert: High error rate on /v1/generate (5xx). #incidents paging triggered. severity: P1. Pager: Priya (oncall)
Priya (oncall): grabbing this. seeing 5xx spike from 18:03 UTC. routing to primary model pool fails. scaling attempts returned 503s.
Priya (oncall): @Eli can you open a temp mitigation? If we can failover to the read-only replica that might buy time.
Eli (SRE): on it. starting canary failover plan from runbook. will flip traffic to fallback model variant (gpt-large-2-quant) for read-heavy routes.
Casey (PM): FYI this impacts hosted customers using streaming generation — likely increased latency and some token loss. I'll notify accounts for top customers after we know scope.
Mateo (support): getting 3 pings already from customer support. adding to shared incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4521
Priya (oncall): Tala (pager) handing off to Eli; I'm going to focus on customer comms.
Eli (SRE): failover started. monitoring for error rate drop. logs: ```ERROR: model_pool_connect: timeout after 15s``` seeing many KV cache misses while switching.
Liam (SRE): can we temporarily reduce max_concurrency to keep runtime stable?
Eli (SRE): lowering max_concurrency on pool-az1 -> 32 (from 64) to reduce OOM risk.
incident-bot: Status update: failover in progress -> 30% traffic on fallback. Error rate decreased from 18% to 6% in 5m.
Ava (eng): quick note — recent kernel update landed on dedicated nodes last night. rolling back kernel patch might be necessary if we see driver errors. I'm spinning a probe to check gpu driver logs.
Jun (Eng Mgr): keep me posted. if rollback needed we need a scheduled window but prioritize customer impact now.
Priya (oncall): good mitigation. once stable let's schedule postmortem and action items. my suggested immediate action items: 1) postmortem kickoff + owner, 2) identify rollout that introduced kernel change, 3) triage sizing & priority for remediation.
Carol (ops): created an incident channel note and added a short RCA template: https://redwood.internal/incidents/templates/short-rca
PagerDuty Bot: Pager duty: incident acknowledged by Eli. Estimated ETA to mitigation: 15-30m.
incident-bot: 20m update: system back to 99.4% (errors at 0.9%), continue monitoring.
Eli (SRE): marking mitigation complete — traffic back to primary model with gradual ramp. leaving fallback available as hot spare.
Priya (oncall): thanks team. we should run a quick retrospective in this thread: who owns full postmortem?
Casey (PM): I'll own postmortem coordination and customer impact summary. Casey will schedule postmortem meeting and collect logs.
Jun (Eng Mgr): engineering action owner: Eli. please create action items with estimates.
Eli (SRE): creating action items now. rough estimates: (A1) investigate kernel patch interactions / root cause — 1.5 engineer-weeks (P0), (A2) add automated rollback check for kernel & driver mismatch — 3 engineer-days (P1), (A3) expand canary rollout to more regions and add soft-failover tests — 2 engineer-weeks (P1), (A4) improve runbook for KV cache warmup and prefetch — 5 engineer-days (P2).
Priya (oncall): let's size by severity: A1 P0 must be in next sprint and flagged for Q2 infra priorities; A3 also high impact for cross-region resilience.
Mateo (support): Customer comms: can we have a one-pager for top 5 affected accounts? I can draft with Casey.
Casey (PM): yes I’ll include an impact matrix. also we should link any billing credit decisions to severity and downtime minutes.
Ava (eng): quick tech addendum: logs show driver OOMs near the time of kernel update. I can reproduce on staging with the same kernel image. I estimate 2-3 days to validate rollback path and test.
Jun (Eng Mgr): good, please put that in the ticket as a subtask with test plan.
Eli (SRE): created JIRA INC-4521#action with items: 
- INC-4521-1 Investigate root cause (owner: Eli) estimate: 1.5w P0
- INC-4521-2 Hot-rollback policy + automation (owner: Ava) estimate: 3d P1
- INC-4521-3 Canary expansion + soft-fail tests (owner: Liam) estimate: 2w P1
- INC-4521-4 Runbook KV cache warming (owner: Priya) estimate: 5d P2
- INC-4521-5 Customer impact one-pager & credits recommendation (owner: Casey & Mateo) estimate: 1d P0
Priya (oncall): ok now prioritization: mark INC-4521-1 and INC-4521-5 as P0 (blocker -> remediation & customer comms). INC-4521-3 P1 but should be in the next quarterly planning sweep to fund cross-region testing.
Casey (PM): scheduling postmortem: proposing Tue 18:00 UTC (60m). Will send invite and attach pre-read (logs + impact spreadsheet).
Priya (oncall): who will run the postmortem facilitation?
Jun (Eng Mgr): I can facilitate. prefer we keep it blameless and action-focused.
Eli (SRE): action item for sizing: I'll break down the 1.5w into tasks and post an updated estimate by EOD.
Ava (eng): I'll start the rollback validation on staging and share logs in the ticket.
Mateo (support): once Casey shares the one-pager I'll prepare the customer messages for top 5 and the broader status update.
Priya (oncall): follow-ups: 1) Casey to create postmortem doc and calendar invite; 2) Eli to break down A1; 3) Ava to validate rollback; 4) Liam to draft canary expansion plan; 5) Priya to coordinate support/customer comms. Please add ETA tags to each JIRA subtask.
Casey (PM): done — postmortem doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INC/pages/4521-postmortem. Meeting invite sent.
incident-bot: Postmortem scheduled by Casey for 1764576000 (Tue) — reminder set.
Priya (oncall): final: good job everyone. let's make sure the action items have owners and a tracking label for the quarterly planning board (Q2-Infra). I'll follow up in our weekly oncall sync. :thumbsup:
Eli (SRE): added Q2-Infra label to the JIRA items. will update estimates here after break down.
Priya (oncall): thread closing for now, will reopen if new major findings come up.
